title: Workers AI line reads fully metered when only some attempts were joined
body:
statusWorkerCost returns a sum for any non-empty set of gateway rows. cost.go then marks the whole workers-ai line Metered with basis "AI Gateway logs" and Attempts counting every workers-ai attempt. Failing input: a resumed epic-<id> run with 30 attempts dispatched before metering existed (or while ~/.ticfacrc named no gateway) and 2 after. The line states a measured $X over 32 attempts, and the 30 unmeasured ones are never called "not metered". Related: the join key is just run_id=epic-<id>, so a later re-run of the same epic, or the same epic id in another repo on the same gateway, sums into this run. Also, after 24u, the classifier's own jev calls carry the same run_id. A run with no Workers AI workers then gets a metered "Workers AI $0.0x (0 attempts)" line while the decisions line says not metered.
evidence: internal/cli/status_model.go:415-443; internal/statusmodel/cost.go:130-135
